name: EPIC 248657863

text.card: A red giant 5,988 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.92 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,887 K at its surface.
